definitions.explanation: A town that developed around a port or harbor, typically associated with maritime trade, fishing, and a distinctive coastal atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{港町|みなとまち}だ。
examples.english: Yokohama is a famous port town.

examples.japanese: {港町|みなとまち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Port towns have many restaurants that serve fresh fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{港町|みなとまち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}している→散歩する：26840_sanposuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧がして{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Walking around the small port town, the scent of the sea was pleasant.

notes:
USAGE:
{港町|みなとまち} is a compound of ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧ (port/harbor) and ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ (town). Japan has many famous port towns including ⟦{横浜|よこはま}→横浜：28138_yokohama⟧, ⟦{神戸|こうべ}→神戸：30710_koube⟧, ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧, and {函館|はこだて}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {港町|みなとまち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (walk around a port town)
- {港町|みなとまち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風情|ふぜい}→風情：09057_fuzei⟧ (the charm of a port town)
- {港町|みなとまち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧ (grow up in a port town)

Port towns in Japan are often associated with foreign cultural influences due to their history as points of international trade. {港町|みなとまち} evokes images of seafood, ocean views, and a blend of Japanese and Western architecture.
